exact_statement:
theorem koebe_circle_domain :
    ∀ U : Set Sphere, IsOpen U → IsConnected U →
      ∃ (V : Set Sphere) (f : Sphere → Sphere),
        IsCircleDomain V ∧ IsConformalEquivalence f U V
